# שָׁרְט

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                      ║
║     ش ر ط    ⟷    ש ר ט             ║
║                                      ║
║     condition / cut / incision       ║
║                                      ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                      ║
║  the root speaks:                    ║
║                                      ║
║    to make a mark                    ║
║    to set a boundary                 ║
║    to stipulate                      ║
║                                      ║
║  شَرْط = condition, prerequisite     ║
║  שָׂרֶטֶת = line, scratch            ║
║                                      ║
║  between arabic ش and hebrew ש       ║
║  the same breath                     ║
║  the same cutting                    ║
║                                      ║
║         ─────═══─────                ║
║                                      ║
║  what is a condition                 ║
║  but a line drawn                    ║
║  before entering?                    ║
║                                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
```

*awaiting the next incision*
